description: RFC 6554 Source Routing Header hop limit validation per LICHEN spec/05-routing.md line 418: Segments Left MUST be strictly less than Hop Limit.

oracle.basis: RFC 8200 Section 4.4, RFC 6554, LICHEN spec/05-routing.md Section 8.4
oracle.rule: Segments Left < Hop Limit (strictly less, not less-or-equal)

vectors.name: srh_segments_left_strictly_less_accept
vectors.description: Segments Left < Hop Limit (3 < 4): strictly less condition satisfied, MUST accept.

vectors.name: srh_segments_left_equal_reject
vectors.description: Segments Left = Hop Limit (3 = 3): not strictly less, MUST reject.

vectors.name: srh_segments_left_greater_reject
vectors.description: Segments Left > Hop Limit (3 > 2): MUST reject.

vectors.name: srh_segments_left_zero_accept
vectors.description: Segments Left = 0 (final destination): strictly less than any positive Hop Limit, MUST accept.

vectors.name: srh_hop_limit_1_segments_0_accept
vectors.description: Hop Limit = 1, Segments Left = 0 (0 < 1): strictly less, MUST accept.

vectors.name: srh_hop_limit_0_reject
vectors.description: Hop Limit = 0: packet should already be discarded before SRH processing, MUST reject if reached.
